#let pub-entry(img-path, title, authors, venue) = {
  block(
    width: 100%,
    stroke: (bottom: 0.5pt + rgb("#e5e7eb")),
    inset: (y: 10pt),
  )[
    #grid(
      columns: (100pt, 1fr),
      gutter: 14pt,
      box(
        clip: true,
        stroke: 0.5pt + rgb("#e5e7eb"),
        image(img-path, width: 100pt),
      ),
      [
        #text(size: 8pt, fill: rgb("#2563eb"), font: "Liberation Mono", weight: "medium")[#upper(venue)]\
        #v(2pt)
        #text(weight: "bold", fill: rgb("#111827"), size: 10pt)[#title]\
        #v(2pt)
        #text(fill: rgb("#6b7280"), size: 9pt)[#authors]
      ],
    )
  ]
}

#pub-entry(
  "images/pubs/Lyapunov.JPG",
  "Efficient Neural Lyapunov Function Approximation with Off-Policy Reinforcement Learning",
  [*L. McCutcheon*, B. Gharesifard, S. Fallah],
  "ICRA 2025",
)

#pub-entry(
  "images/pubs/adaptive-pd.JPG",

)

)

## Reviewing

I serve as a reviewer for the following venues:

- **ICLR 2026** — International Conference on Learning Representations
- **NeurIPS 2025** — Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems
- **TNNLS 2025** — IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems
- **IROS 2025** — IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems
